تحترمي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِمِي (taḥtarimī) /taħ.ta.ri.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# تُحْتَرَمِي (tuḥtaramī) /tuħ.ta.ra.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
